settings.editor:
KTC Towing is a local Calgary towing and vehicle recovery company. We are based at 347 39 Ave SE, and our drivers know how a Calgary winter behaves: batteries that fail at -30, icy back roads that put cars in ditches, and the stress of finding a vehicle in the impound lot.

Our fleet is matched to the job. Flatbeds move vehicles with zero wheels on the road, wheel-lift trucks handle quick city tows, winch gear pulls vehicles out of snow and ditches, and heavy-duty trucks handle work vehicles, RVs and trailers. You get a clear quote first, an honest ETA, and a driver who explains each step.

settings.title: Towing and Roadside Services in Calgary

settings.editor: We send the right truck the first time, 24/7. Here's everything we handle, grouped by what you need.

settings.description_text_b: A breakdown or collision can leave you stranded somewhere unsafe. Our 24/7 emergency towing in Calgary gets a truck to you fast, with an average arrival of about 20 minutes, and moves your vehicle safely to a repair shop, home or storage yard.

Not every problem needs a tow sometimes you just need a hand to get going. Our roadside assistance in Calgary covers the most common issues local drivers hit, often solving them on the spot so you keep driving.

Calgary winters are brutal on batteries. KTC's jump start service in Calgary arrives with the gear to safely boost your vehicle no waiting in the cold. If the battery's done, we'll tow you to a repair shop.
A flat doesn't have to wreck your day. KTC's flat tire change service in Calgary swaps it for your spare quickly and safely roadside or in a lot. No usable spare? We'll tow you to a tire shop.
Locked your keys inside? Our technicians open your vehicle without damaging the door, lock, or window, and get you back behind the wheel in minutes anywhere in Calgary.
Out of gas? Don't risk walking a busy Calgary Road. KTC's fuel delivery service in Calgary brings enough fuel right to your vehicle wherever you are to reach the nearest station.

The safest way to transport luxury cars, lowered vehicles, AWD and electric vehicles, motorcycles, and damaged cars fully lifted onto the deck for damage-free transport. Our flatbed tow trucks serve NE, NW, SE & SW Calgary, ready to dispatch anywhere in the city, 24/7
Bikes need special handling. KTC uses the right equipment and soft-tie techniques to transport your motorcycle safely and upright across Calgary no scratches, no drops
Not every job fits a standard tow truck. KTC tows larger vehicles, trucks, buses, RVs, and commercial vehicles across Calgary, with specialized equipment and trained operators.
Motorhomes, travel trailers, and campers take experience and the right rig. KTC transports large recreational vehicles and trailers across Calgary with care.
Need a vehicle moved between cities or out of province? KTC covers Calgary, Alberta, and beyond with flat-rate pricing no surprise per-kilometer charges.

Unauthorized or expired-permit vehicles in a condo, apartment, or commercial parkade in Calgary. We work with property managers and boards on signed towing authorization, then remove violating vehicles quickly and by the book, no damage to the stall, gate, or nearby cars.

Low clearance, tight turns, and concrete pillars make underground parkade towing a different job entirely. Our low-profile equipment and trained operators safely extract vehicles from Calgary's underground and multi-level parking structures, no scraped roofs, no damaged columns.
Stuck in snow, mud, or a ditch? KTC's winch-out and recovery service in Calgary uses proper equipment to pull your vehicle back onto solid ground without further damage
After a collision, your vehicle should be the last thing you worry about. We clear the scene safely and transport your vehicle to a repair facility or storage anywhere in Calgary.
As an authorized impound recovery partner, KTC helps you get your vehicle released from the Calgary impound lot including the City of Calgary impound lot and moved fast, before storage fees climb.

settings.title: Towing Calgary: Fast Tow Truck Service Across the Whole City

settings.editor:
When you search for towing Calgary drivers can rely on, you want three things: a truck that arrives quickly, the right equipment for your vehicle, and a price that is clear before the hook-up. That is how KTC Towing runs every call.

Calgary is a big, spread-out city, and where you break down changes the job. A stalled car on Deerfoot Trail at rush hour is a safety problem, and our dispatcher will ask for your direction of travel and nearest exit so the driver can reach you fast. A car that will not start in a downtown parkade needs low-profile equipment. A vehicle slid into a snowbank on a Tuscany or Saddle Ridge side street needs winch gear, not just a standard tow. We handle all of these, 24 hours a day, from our base at 347 39 Ave SE.

Our tow truck Calgary team covers the main routes drivers use every day: Deerfoot Trail, Stoney Trail, Crowchild Trail, Glenmore Trail, Macleod Trail, the Trans-Canada Highway (Highway 1) and 16 Avenue NW. We also tow across the NE, NW, SE and SW quadrants, to and from the airport area, and out to Chestermere, Airdrie, Cochrane, Okotoks and High River.

Whether you need emergency towing in Calgary after an accident, a flatbed tow for an AWD or electric vehicle, a jump start on a freezing morning, or help getting your car out of the impound lot, one call to (587) 435-0770 is enough. We confirm the truck, the arrival time and the price before we dispatch.

settings.title_text: My car broke down on a Calgary highway
settings.description_text: Move to the shoulder if you can, turn on your hazards, and stay buckled in if traffic is heavy. Call KTC at (587) 435-0770 and tell us the highway, direction and nearest exit or cross street. We send the nearest truck and confirm your arrival time.

settings.title_text: I was in an accident in Calgary
settings.description_text: Check that everyone is safe and call 911 if anyone is hurt. Once the scene is safe, we handle accident towing in Calgary to the body shop or storage yard you or your insurer choose.

settings.title_text: My car will not start in the cold
settings.description_text: Calgary winters drain batteries quickly. We can usually jump start the vehicle on the spot. If it still will not start, we tow it to a shop of your choice.

settings.title_text: My vehicle is stuck in snow or a ditch
settings.description_text: Do not keep spinning the wheels. Call us for winch-out and recovery, and we pull the vehicle out without causing extra damage.

settings.title_text: My car was towed to the impound lot
settings.description_text: Gather your photo ID, proof of ownership and insurance, and confirm the lot's fees and hours. After it is released, KTC transports your vehicle wherever it needs to go.

settings.title_text: I need a tow to my mechanic or dealership
settings.description_text: Give us the shop address and tell us if your car is AWD, lowered or damaged. We send a flatbed or wheel-lift truck to match.

settings.title_text: I am locked out or out of fuel
settings.description_text: We come to you with lockout tools or fuel delivery so you can keep driving, with no tow needed.

settings.title: Winter Towing in Calgary: What to Expect

settings.editor:
Calgary cold snaps drain batteries fast, and snow-packed streets and parking lots lead to slide-offs and stuck vehicles. In winter our most common calls are jump starts and winch-outs.

If you are stuck: turn on your hazards, stay in the vehicle if you are on a busy road, and call us with your nearest cross streets. Keep a winter kit (blanket, jumper cables, phone charger) in your car.

Read more: What to Do If You Are Stuck in Snow in Calgary

settings.title: Calgary's Trusted Towing Team, When You Need Us Most

settings.editor: Nobody plans on needing a tow. When it happens, you want a company that knows the city, shows up fast, and treats your vehicle like their own. That's what KTC Towing has built its name on.

settings.description_text: Our dispatchers aren't reading off a script. Tell us your location and what happened, a breakdown, a collision, a vehicle that just won't start, and we'll know exactly what kind of truck and driver to send.
We don't send just anyone. Our drivers know the routes, the neighborhoods, and how to navigate Calgary traffic and winter conditions so they get to you quickly and safely, no matter where you are.

Whether it's a quick fix on the shoulder or a full tow to a shop or impound lot, we treat your vehicle the way we'd want ours treated. And if insurance paperwork is involved, we take that off your plate too.

settings.editor: Tows start at $50 CAD for a standard light-duty tow within Calgary. The final price depends on vehicle type, distance and time of day, and we give you a clear quote before the truck is dispatched. For heavy-duty, recovery or impound transport, we provide a custom estimate.

You typically need valid photo ID, proof of ownership, valid insurance, and payment for any outstanding impound and storage fees. Requirements vary by lot, so call the facility first. As an authorized recovery partner, KTC Towing can then transport your released vehicle wherever it needs to go.
Transport cost depends on the impound lot location and your destination. We quote you upfront before dispatch. Note that the impound facility charges its impound and daily storage fees separately.
Our average arrival time for emergency calls in Calgary is about 20 minutes, and we confirm your ETA before we hang up. Traffic and weather can affect timing.
Yes. KTC Towing dispatch is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year, including holidays and long weekends. Call (587) 435-0770 or message us on WhatsApp any time, day or night.
Yes, for luxury, lowered, AWD, electric, and damaged vehicles, for damage-free transport.

settings._title: Can you tow from an underground parkade?

settings.editor: Yes. We use low-profile equipment and trained operators for underground and multi-level parkades.

settings._title: Do I need a flatbed for my AWD car?

settings.editor: Usually yes. AWD and 4x4 drivetrains can be damaged when only some wheels roll, so a flatbed is the safer choice. Mention your vehicle when you call.
All of Calgary, NE, NW, SE, and SW, plus Chestermere, Airdrie, Cochrane, Okotoks, and High River. We also offer long-distance towing across Alberta.
Yes. Our winch-out and recovery service safely pulls vehicles from snow, mud, and ditches, common during Calgary winters.

We tow almost everything on the road: cars, SUVs, minivans, pickup trucks, AWD and electric vehicles, lowered and luxury cars, and motorcycles. For bigger jobs, our heavy-duty trucks handle cube vans, work trucks, buses, RVs, travel trailers, and commercial vehicles. Tell our dispatcher your vehicle and situation, and we’ll send the right truck: flatbed, wheel-lift, winch, or heavy-duty. Not sure if we can move yours?
